title: NSGo game voxel world (version 1)
description: WorldDoc is the root of a versioned YAML voxel world document.

version.description: Version is the schema version; must be 1.

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable name for the world.

chunkSize.description: ChunkSize is the power-of-two cubic chunk edge length, from 4 to 64.

voxelSize.description: VoxelSize is the world-space edge length of one voxel; omitted or 0 defaults to 1.

palette.description: Palette lists the non-air block definitions used by the world, sorted by ID.

chunks.description: Chunks lists the non-empty chunks in the world, sorted by (x, y, z).

BlockDoc.description: BlockDoc describes one non-air block type in a [WorldDoc] palette.

id.description: ID is the non-zero numeric block ID referenced by chunk runs.

name.description: Name is the unique human-readable name of the block type.

transparent.description: Transparent marks blocks whose neighbors remain visible behind them (such as glass or water).

nonSolid.description: NonSolid marks blocks excluded from solid collision and default raycasts.

materialId.description: MaterialID groups emitted faces into SubMesh ranges when meshing.

emissive.description: Emissive is the block light level (0..15) emitted into the block-light channel.

lightOpacity.description: LightOpacity is the light attenuation (0..15) for transparent blocks; 0 lets direct sky light pass and attenuates propagated light by 1.

ChunkDoc.description: ChunkDoc stores one non-empty chunk using run-length encoded block runs in (y, z, x) order.

x.description: X is the chunk's X index in chunk-grid coordinates.

y.description: Y is the chunk's Y index in chunk-grid coordinates.

z.description: Z is the chunk's Z index in chunk-grid coordinates.

runs.description: Runs holds run-length encoded block tokens ("id*count" or "id" for count 1) in (y, z, x) order whose counts sum to chunkSize^3.
